title: Is it resonance or a different skeleton?
hints: Keep atom positions and electron count fixed.
solution: The three resonance drawings keep the same three N–O connections and exchange which one is represented by a double bond.
statement:
Which change is allowed between resonance contributors for nitrate?

[_]{a}

choices: Moving the double-bond placement to another N–O connection.
Replacing N with a different element.
Moving an O into the center and N to the edge.
Adding two electrons to only one contributor.
explanations: The centers remain connected the same way.
All contributors describe the same charge and electron count.
